truth.title: apply-this-truth-feature-with-custom-one-time-instructions
truth.content: We have "Apply this truth" button, along with that, we should have a checkbox with message "Provide custom one time instructions". Its default value should be unchecked. If it is checked, then when the user clicks "Apply this truth" button, then we shall prompt the user to provide custom one time instructions which would also be passed as part of the prompt for "claude -p ..." command which is going to be run.

truth.title: populate-button-for-hyphenated-title-in-edit-mode
truth.content: When we are in edit mode for a "truth", the "hyphenated-title" field should have a button right next to it called "Populate" which would populate the value of the field based on the "truth" content from the textarea below.
